title: Invitation to media and analyst briefing for Ericsson Q3 2026 report
summary: Ericsson's Q3 2026 report will be published at approximately 7:00 AM CEST on October 15, 2026.
body_markdown:
Ericsson's (NASDAQ: ERIC) financial report for the third quarter 2026 will be published at approximately 7:00 AM CEST on October 15, 2026. The company will issue a press release with the complete financial report attached, including tables, in PDF format. Following publication of the press release, the financial report will be available on Ericsson's website:


[https://www.ericsson.com/en/investors](https://www.ericsson.com/en/investors)


President and CEO Per Narvinger and CFO Lars Sandström will comment on the report and take questions at a live video webcast at 9:00 AM CEST (8:00 AM BST London, 3:00 AM EDT New York).


[Join the webcast](https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/x9wm6h6u/) or please go to[www.ericsson.com/investors](https://www.ericsson.com/investors)


To ask a question: Access dial-in information[here](https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BI2ad0a8d87ec447e1a07473d562fa427d)


The webcast will be available on-demand after the event and can be viewed on our website.
